column1: # CALLSEQ.tsv -- P05-S4 R3-1 discovery, NO injection.  Produced by r3_callseq_parse.py from
# checkpoints/p05/evidence/p05-s4r3/discovery/*.log.  Columns: route, mode, tree, rep, category,
# nth (gdb global call index, equal to the injector counter), size (S4_malloc only, bytes),
# caller_function (from info symbol of the return address), caller_file (NONE: no debug info),
# return_address (hex).  The discovery measures call order only; it is not repair evidence.
